      ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
        primitivePairCoefficient d q r *

            if m.Coprime (q * r) then d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m else 0) -

theorem actualU_sub_primitive_finite_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d →
      ‖(d.transposedAtom.complexDispersionU d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier
        d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) - primitiveZeroMain d‖ ≤
          C * ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
            ‖primitivePairCoefficient d q r‖ * ((q * r).divisors.card : ℝ)

all_complete_definition_source_blocks.complete_definition_source_block:
def primitivePairCoefficient (d : MediumAtom) (q r : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  d.groupedFactorGamma q * star (d.groupedFactorGamma r) *
    coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha q * star (coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha r) /
      ((q.totient : ℂ) * (r.totient : ℂ))

independent_semantic_findings: alpha_l1_le_twice_U uses exactly the original alphaCarrier interval filter and the original admissible pointwise |alpha|<=1; positive U makes it a subset of Ioc 0 floor(2U), yielding <=2U. coprimeMass only discards terms before applying this bound.

actual_principalRow_eq_grouped first uses exact transposed-beta extension by zero to return to the original alpha interval. Coprime(m*n,q) splits into coprime(m,q) and coprime(n,q). Full original three-factor complex gamma labels are then grouped exactly by physical modulus; no gamma norm is substituted during this identity.

primitivePairCoefficient is groupedGamma(q)*conj(groupedGamma(r))*Cq*conj(Cr)/(phi(q)*phi(r)). The squared principal row expands into this coefficient times coprime(m,q*r). This is exact complex Hermitian algebra, valid with total division even for degenerate data.
actualU_eq_coprime_sum retains the original-V common smoothing and common finite carrier of the transposed atom. Finite sums commute to put the smooth coprime count inside each physical-modulus pair.

primitiveZeroMain_eq_grouped groups the exact full-label P0. Its scalar is original V times local cutoffMass and its density is phi(q*r)/(phi(q)*phi(r)*(q*r)), exactly matching primitivePairCoefficient times V*localMass*phi(q*r)/(q*r). No external integral scalar is substituted.
actualU_sub_primitive_eq is the exact difference, with the literal U expression preserved. It does not identify literal U with P0.

actualU_sub_primitive_finite_bound chooses one positive C before every B,sigma,kappa,c0,d. Physical q,r are positive by the existing subset-cap theorem. The local smooth coprime theorem at modulus q*r, scale V>0 and the actual support-containing carrier gives C*tau_2(q*r). Multiplying by coefficient norms and summing proves the displayed finite envelope; this envelope is a conclusion, not an extra caller assumption.

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: coprimeMass
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_source_header:
def coprimeMass {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (N : Finset ℕ) (beta : ℕ → R) (q : ℕ) : R
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_definition_source_block:
def coprimeMass {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (N : Finset ℕ) (beta : ℕ → R) (q : ℕ) : R :=
  ∑ n ∈ N, if n.Coprime q then beta n else 0

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: primitiveZeroMain
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_definition_source_block:
def primitiveZeroMain (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ((d.V * CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    ∑ a ∈ d.complexFactorLabels, ∑ b ∈ d.complexFactorLabels,
      d.complexFactorGamma a * star (d.complexFactorGamma b) *
        coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha (complexFactorModulus a) *
          star (coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha (complexFactorModulus b)) *
            (((complexFactorModulus a * complexFactorModulus b).totient : ℂ) /
              (((complexFactorModulus a).totient : ℂ) *
                ((complexFactorModulus b).totient : ℂ) *
                  (complexFactorModulus a * complexFactorModulus b : ℕ)))

/-- Zero-mode discrepancy is exactly the original-alpha covariance,
with each original complex factor fiber retained by an exact identity. -/

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: factor_pair_sum_eq_grouped
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_source_header:
theorem factor_pair_sum_eq_grouped (d : MediumAtom) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ a ∈ d.complexFactorLabels, ∑ b ∈ d.complexFactorLabels,
      d.complexFactorGamma a * star (d.complexFactorGamma b) *
        f (complexFactorModulus a) (complexFactorModulus b)) =
      ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
        d.groupedFactorGamma q * star (d.groupedFactorGamma r) * f q r

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_coprime_uniform_error
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_source_header:
theorem scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_coprime_uniform_error :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M → ∀ S : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ m : ℕ, scaledDyadicCutoff M m ≠ 0 → m ∈ S) →
      ∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ 0 →
      |(∑ m ∈ S, if m.Coprime q then scaledDyadicCutoff M m else 0) -
          (M * cutoffMass) * (q.totient : ℝ) / q| ≤ C * q.divisors.card

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: MediumAtom.transposedAtom
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_definition_source_block:
def MediumAtom.transposedAtom (d : MediumAtom) : MediumAtom :=
  { d with
    U := d.V
    V := d.U
    intervalLo := -1
    intervalHi := (Nat.floor (2 * d.V) : ℝ)
    alpha := d.beta
    beta := fun n ↦ if n ∈ d.alphaCarrier then d.alpha n else 0 }

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: MediumAtom.sum_transposedBeta_mul
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_source_header:
theorem MediumAtom.sum_transposedBeta_mul (d : MediumAtom) (f : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ n ∈ d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier, d.transposedAtom.beta n * f n) =
      ∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n * f n

theorem MediumAtom.transposedSmoothWeight_support_subset
    {d : MediumAtom} (hV : 1 ≤ d.V) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight n ≠ 0) :
    n ∈ d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: MediumAtom.complexPrincipalRow
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_definition_source_block:
def MediumAtom.complexPrincipalRow (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexFactorGamma l.1 * d.beta l.2 *
      (if (n * l.2).Coprime (complexFactorModulus l.1) then 1 else 0) /
        (Nat.totient (complexFactorModulus l.1) : ℂ)

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: MediumAtom.complexDispersionU
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_source_header:
def MediumAtom.complexDispersionU (d : MediumAtom) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_definition_source_block:
def MediumAtom.complexDispersionU (d : MediumAtom) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ S, w n * ‖d.complexPrincipalRow n‖ ^ 2

/-- The complex cross term uses its real part, with the primitive centre
retained. It is not the product of two real surrogate rows. -/

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: complex_norm_sq_sum_eq_double_star
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_source_header:
theorem complex_norm_sq_sum_eq_double_star {iota : Type*} (S : Finset iota)
    (f : iota → ℂ) :
    ((‖∑ i ∈ S, f i‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ∑ i ∈ S, ∑ j ∈ S, f i * star (f j)

def MediumAtom.physicalFactorModuli (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=

MediumAtom.sum_factorLabels_eq_grouped

theorem MediumAtom.sum_factorLabels_eq_grouped (d : MediumAtom) (F : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ r ∈ d.complexFactorLabels, d.complexFactorGamma r * F (complexFactorModulus r)) =
      ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, d.groupedFactorGamma q * F q
